platform: Radio One 91FM Dunedin Music Director Digital Download and Physical Airplay Route
manual_review_reason: Radio One publishes music@r1.co.nz for music submissions and a separate physical-delivery address. Its linked alternative-radio guidance recommends a personal email, a descriptive subject, contact and origin details, a correctly named and tagged minimum-320-kbps MP3 download link, focus tracks and a one-page information sheet. The guidance is framed around New Zealand artists, while the station says it supports independent and alternative music from Aotearoa and beyond; international eligibility is therefore not explicit. A human must reconfirm that a Netherlands-based MarcsMusic release is eligible, select the appropriate track or release, verify rights, content labels and AI-origin acceptability, prepare the permitted download and metadata, and send manually. Physical delivery also requires manual handling.

platform: Radio Control 99.4FM Palmerston North Music Submissions Email Route
manual_review_reason: Radio Control's official Contact page publishes music@radiocontrol.org.nz specifically for Music Submissions, but it does not state accepted codecs, minimum bitrate, attachment or download-link method, release-age window, metadata, rights, content-warning, AI-origin or response requirements. The page also lists a postal address, but does not explicitly authorize it for physical music submissions, so it was not queued as a delivery route. A human must reconfirm current eligibility and international acceptance, request clarification if necessary, select a genre-appropriate MarcsMusic release, prepare a non-expiring stream or download only if permitted, verify rights and content labels, and send manually.
